test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given graph showing the rainfall (in mm) in three cities, i.e. Delhi, Mumbai and Chennai from the year 2000 to 2003 and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f89d0773b8d51f9c33e4d3c4e88130510f101e32fbe69856d51343be600304be.png] 

Select the option indicating the city with the highest rainfall along with its average rainfall?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total rainfall in Delhi in all 4 years (in mm)= (50 + 70 + 110 + 60) = 290

Average rainfall in Delhi in all four years = 290 / 4 = 72.5 mm

Total rainfall in Mumbai in all 4 years (in mm)= (70 + 90 + 80 + 130) = 370

Average rainfall in Mumbai in all four years = 370 / 4 = 72.5 mm

Total rainfall in Chennai in all 4 years (in mm)= (90 + 80 + 140 + 80) = 390

Average rainfall in Chennai in all four years = 290 / 4 = 97.5 mm

**∴ The city with the highest rainfall along with its average rainfall is Chennai with 97.5 mm rainfall.**
